newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Moroccan King meets Kuwait's envoy.
newsitem.headline: Moroccan King meets Kuwait's envoy.

text.p: Morocco's King Hassan on Tuesday received Kuwait's Emir Sheikh Jaber al-Ahmed al-Sabah's envoy at his royal palace of Skhirat near Rabat, the Moroccan official news agency MAP said.

Abderrahmane Salim al-Uteiki, Adviser of the Kuwaiti ruler, said at his arrival in the North African country that he would brief the monarch on the latest developments in the Middle East, MAP reported without giving more details.
Kuwait has invited 3,000 U.S. ground troops to boost its defences and allowed U.S. stealth bombers to operate from its territory in the latest confrontation between Washington and Baghdad.
The Kuwaiti Emir has dispatched on Monday officials to tour Lebanon, Libya, and non-Arab Iran and Turkey.
Other senior Kuwaiti officials have already visited several 1991 Gulf War Arab allies and Russia to explain Kuwait's stand and the need for the U.S. military buildup in the Gulf.
